concepts.name: Consultation Session Lifecycle
concepts.summary: A Session is the durable record of one counselling case between an asker (User) and one or more consultants; it is created at registration or enquiry time, assigned to a consultant, archived, dearchived and finally deleted. The state machine lives in api/service/session/SessionService.java with the facades api/facade/CreateSessionFacade.java, api/facade/CreateEnquiryMessageFacade.java and api/service/archive/SessionArchiveService.java. Sessions carry topics, consulting type, agency, consent and an optional SessionSupervisor row managed via api/facade/SessionSupervisorFacade.java.

concepts.name: Consultation Modes (registered, anonymous, team, group chat)
concepts.summary: The service supports several counselling modes on top of the same Session/Chat model: registered one-to-one sessions, anonymous live conversations, team sessions shared inside an agency, and moderated group chats. Anonymous conversations are created and finished by api/conversation/facade/CreateAnonymousEnquiryFacade.java and api/conversation/facade/FinishAnonymousConversationFacade.java, while group chats live in api/model/Chat.java plus api/facade/CreateChatFacade.java and api/service/chat. Which list a consultant sees is resolved by the provider registry in api/conversation/registry/ConversationListProviderRegistry.java.

concepts.name: Matrix-backed Messaging Bridge
concepts.summary: All chat traffic is stored in a Matrix/Synapse homeserver, not in this service; UserService only owns the room ids, the Matrix user ids and the membership rules. The outbound side is api/adapters/matrix/MatrixSynapseService.java and api/adapters/matrix/MatrixRoomClient.java behind the ports api/port/out/MatrixUserClient.java and api/port/out/SessionRoomGateway.java; the inbound side is api/service/matrix/MatrixEventListenerService.java. System messages and membership changes are pushed through api/service/matrix/MatrixSessionSystemMessageService.java and api/service/matrix/GroupChatMembershipService.java.

concepts.name: Asker vs. Consultant Identity
concepts.summary: The two principal account types are api/model/User.java (asker / advice seeker, possibly anonymous) and api/model/Consultant.java (counsellor, linked to agencies through api/model/ConsultantAgency.java). Both are mirrored into Keycloak and into Matrix, and both carry a Matrix password column added by the addMatrixPasswordToUser.sql / addMatrixPasswordToConsultant.sql changesets. Anonymous askers get generated display names from api/conversation/service/user/anonymous/AnonymousUsernameRegistry.java, and usernames are Base32-transcoded by api/helper/UsernameTranscoder.java so that the readable name never has to be stored in clear text.

concepts.name: Keycloak Identity, 2FA and Passwordless Entry
concepts.summary: Keycloak is the identity provider; every account operation goes through api/adapters/keycloak/KeycloakService.java, which is hidden behind the fine-grained ports in api/port/out (IdentityClient, IdentityRoleUpdater, IdentitySecondFactor, IdentitySessionExchange). Second factor setup — app TOTP and e-mail OTP — is exposed on /otp-config/* and /users/2fa/* and reaches Keycloak through api/port/out/IdentitySecondFactor.java. Passwordless entry paths are api/service/auth/MagicLinkLoginService.java and api/service/auth/PasswordResetService.java, both backed by the Redis one-time token store api/service/auth/RedisOneTimeTokenStore.java.

concepts.name: Multitenancy and Tenant Context
concepts.summary: Every request is bound to a tenant before business code runs. api/adapters/web/controller/interceptor/HttpTenantFilter.java calls api/tenant/TenantResolverService.java, which tries subdomain, access-token claim, custom header and technical/super-admin resolvers in order and stores the result in the thread-local api/tenant/TenantContext.java. Persistence is filtered by api/service/TenantHibernateInterceptor.java and the tenant_id column introduced by the tenant_id.sql changeset, so entities marked api/model/TenantAware.java are never read across tenants.

concepts.name: User, Consultant and Admin Administration
concepts.summary: The /useradmin and /agencyadmin surfaces let tenant admins, agency admins and support admins manage consultants, askers, admins and agency relations. api/adapters/web/controller/UserAdminController.java delegates to api/admin/facade/ConsultantAdminFacade.java, api/admin/facade/AdminUserFacade.java and api/admin/facade/AskerUserAdminFacade.java, which in turn drive the saga api/admin/service/consultant/create/CreateConsultantSaga.java and the filter/search services under api/admin/service. A separate rule engine under api/admin/report produces consistency violation reports for /useradmin/report.

concepts.name: Case Handover
concepts.summary: A consultant can hand a running case to a colleague; the request, its reason and its acceptance are persisted in api/model/CaseHandoverRequest.java against the case_handover_request table, with allowed reasons governed by api/model/CaseHandoverReasonPolicy.java. api/service/CaseHandoverService.java performs the transfer, rewires Matrix room membership and writes an audit trail read back through api/service/CaseHandoverLogsService.java. The HTTP surface is api/adapters/web/controller/CaseHandoverController.java.

concepts.name: Invite Links and Account Invitations
concepts.summary: Two distinct invitation mechanisms coexist. api/model/AgencyInviteLink.java plus api/service/agencyinvitelink/AgencyInviteLinkService.java produce shareable links that drop an asker straight into an agency or topic with a chosen anonymity and chat type. api/model/AccountInvite.java plus api/service/accountinvite/AccountInviteService.java invite staff — counsellors, agency admins, tenant admins — by e-mail, tracked through invite_email_template and invite_email_delivery and provisioned by api/service/accountinvite/CounsellorInviteProvisioningService.java.

concepts.name: Live Availability and Event Notifications
concepts.summary: Consultant presence is tracked in memory by api/service/availability/ConsultantActivityRegistry.java, fed by api/config/ConsultantActivityInterceptor.java and exposed on /users/consultants live-availability endpoints via api/adapters/web/controller/ConsultantLiveAvailabilityController.java. In-app events are persisted as api/model/EventNotification.java rows written by api/service/notification/EventNotificationService.java, deduplicated by api/service/notification/EventNotificationDeduplicationWriter.java and pruned by the retention scheduler in api/workflow/notificationretention.

concepts.name: Notifications and Branded E-Mail
concepts.summary: Outgoing mail is assembled locally rather than delegated wholesale: api/service/emailsupplier holds one EmailSupplier per occasion (new enquiry, assignment, reassignment) and api/service/email/layout/BrandedEmailLayoutRenderer.java wraps the body in the tenant's branding resolved by api/service/email/layout/EmailBrandingResolver.java. api/facade/EmailNotificationFacade.java is the orchestration point, api/service/helper/MailService.java the transport to the ORISO MailService, and api/service/mobilepushmessage/MobilePushNotificationService.java the Firebase push path.

concepts.name: Appointments and Booking
concepts.summary: api/model/Appointment.java stores counselling appointments with an optional external booking id (migrate-add-booking-id-to-appointment.sql), and api/service/appointment/AppointmentService.java plus api/adapters/web/controller/AppointmentController.java expose /appointments including the enquiry-creating POST /appointments/sessions/{sessionId}/enquiry/new. The AppointmentService REST client factories in api/config/apiclient (AppointmentAgencyServiceApiControllerFactory and siblings) show that event types, slots and bookings live in a separate ORISO appointment service that this repo only calls out to.

concepts.name: Account Deletion and Deactivation Lifecycle
concepts.summary: Deletion is a scheduled, multi-step workflow rather than a single DELETE. api/workflow/delete/service/DeleteUserAccountService.java runs an ordered chain of ActionCommands under api/workflow/delete/action/asker and .../consultant that remove database rows, Keycloak accounts and Matrix users, recording failures via api/workflow/delete/service/WorkflowErrorLogService.java. api/workflow/delete/service/DeletionLifecycleService.java tracks the DeletionLifecycleState and read-only-until window from alterDeletionLifecycle.sql, and api/workflow/delete/service/IdentityTombstoneService.java keeps an identity_tombstone so a freed username is not silently reused.

concepts.name: Statistics and Audit Logs
concepts.summary: Business events are emitted as typed StatisticsEvent objects (RegistrationStatisticsEvent, AssignSessionStatisticsEvent, Start/StopVideoCallStatisticsEvent) through api/service/statistics/StatisticsService.java to the separate ORISO statistics service. Read models for the admin dashboard are computed in-repo by api/service/statistics/AdminDashboardStatisticsService.java and api/service/statistics/ConsultantStatisticsService.java, with per-consultant message counts pre-aggregated into consultant_message_stat and consultant identities hashed by api/service/statistics/ConsultantIdentityHasher.java. Separate audit trails exist for supervisors, case handovers and inactive-account notifications.

concepts.name: Persistence, JPA Ports and Liquibase Migrations
concepts.summary: The schema is owned by Liquibase changesets under src/main/resources/db/changelog (from initTables.sql through the tenant, appointment, invite, case-handover, handshake and support-room migrations) and applied by api/config/LiquibaseConfig.java and api/config/BeanAwareSpringLiquibase.java, guarded at boot by api/config/SchemaMigrationGuard.java. Application code never talks to Hibernate directly: every entity in api/model is reached through a Spring Data interface in api/port/out, which is what keeps the hexagonal boundary enforceable by the module-boundary CI test.

flows.name: Asker registers and submits enquiry → Session with Matrix room
flows.summary: POST /users/askers/new reaches api/adapters/web/controller/UserRegistrationControllerDelegate.java → api/facade/CreateUserFacade.java, which creates the Keycloak account via api/adapters/keycloak/KeycloakService.java and the User row, then api/facade/CreateSessionFacade.java persists a Session. The asker then calls POST /users/sessions/{sessionId}/enquiry/new, handled by api/facade/CreateEnquiryMessageFacade.java: it creates the Matrix room through api/adapters/matrix/MatrixSynapseService.java, writes the first message, updates the Session to NEW and triggers the new-enquiry mail via api/service/emailsupplier/NewEnquiryEmailSupplier.java. Any partial failure is undone by api/facade/rollback/RollbackFacade.java.

flows.name: Consultant accepts enquiry → Session assigned
flows.summary: The consultant lists open enquiries via GET /conversations/consultants/enquiries/registered on api/adapters/web/controller/ConversationController.java, served by api/conversation/provider/RegisteredEnquiryConversationListProvider.java. Assignment goes through PUT /users/sessions/{sessionId}/consultant/{consultantId} into api/facade/assignsession/AssignEnquiryFacade.java, which validates eligibility with api/facade/assignsession/SessionToConsultantVerifier.java, removes non-entitled Matrix members computed by api/facade/assignsession/UnauthorizedMembersProvider.java, flips the Session to IN_PROGRESS through api/service/session/SessionService.java and emits an AssignSessionStatisticsEvent.

flows.name: Anonymous asker starts and finishes a live conversation
flows.summary: POST /conversations/askers/anonymous/new hits api/adapters/web/controller/ConversationController.java → api/conversation/facade/CreateAnonymousEnquiryFacade.java, which mints a throwaway identity in api/conversation/service/user/anonymous/AnonymousUserCreatorService.java using a name reserved by api/conversation/service/user/anonymous/AnonymousUsernameRegistry.java and creates the session and Matrix room via api/conversation/service/AnonymousConversationCreatorService.java. A consultant claims it with PUT /conversations/askers/anonymous/{sessionId}/accept; PUT /conversations/anonymous/{sessionId}/finish runs api/conversation/facade/FinishAnonymousConversationFacade.java, and abandoned anonymous accounts are reaped later by api/workflow/deactivate/scheduler/DeactivateAnonymousUserScheduler.java.

flows.name: Message travels Matrix → UserService → notification
flows.summary: Synapse pushes room events to api/adapters/web/controller/MatrixSyncController.java, which forwards them to api/service/matrix/MatrixEventListenerService.java. That service resolves the session or chat behind the room id via api/service/session/SessionService.java, updates message bookkeeping such as api/service/statistics/ConsultantMessageStatService.java, and decides who must be told. Recipients are notified by e-mail through api/facade/EmailNotificationFacade.java, in-app through api/service/notification/EventNotificationService.java and on mobile through api/service/mobilepushmessage/MobilePushNotificationService.java, respecting api/service/donotdisturb/DoNotDisturbService.java.

flows.name: Consultant hands a case to a colleague
flows.summary: The requesting consultant posts to api/adapters/web/controller/CaseHandoverController.java, which calls api/service/CaseHandoverService.java. The service checks the reason against api/model/CaseHandoverReasonPolicy.java, persists a CaseHandoverRequest through api/port/out/CaseHandoverRequestRepository.java and notifies the target. On acceptance the session's consultant is swapped via api/service/session/SessionService.java, Matrix room membership is rewritten through api/adapters/matrix/MatrixSessionAssignmentGateway.java, and the whole exchange is retrievable as an audit trail from api/service/CaseHandoverLogsService.java.

flows.name: Admin creates a consultant → Keycloak, Matrix and agency relations
flows.summary: POST /useradmin/consultants enters api/adapters/web/controller/UserAdminController.java → api/admin/facade/ConsultantAdminFacade.java → api/admin/service/consultant/create/CreateConsultantSaga.java. The saga validates the input with api/admin/service/consultant/validation/UserAccountInputValidator.java, creates the Keycloak account and roles, provisions the Matrix user, and stores the Consultant row; agency links are then added by api/admin/service/consultant/create/agencyrelation/ConsultantAgencyRelationCreatorService.java, which also joins the consultant into the agency's existing session rooms. Failing steps are rolled back by the compensator in api/service/provisioning/ProvisioningCompensator.java.

flows.name: Staff member is invited by e-mail → onboarded account
flows.summary: An admin creates an invitation on api/adapters/web/controller/AccountInviteController.java → api/service/accountinvite/AccountInviteService.java, which renders the template from api/service/accountinvite/InviteEmailTemplateService.java, builds the accept URL with api/service/accountinvite/InviteAcceptUrlBuilder.java and sends it via api/service/accountinvite/mail/InviteMailDispatchService.java, recording success or failure in invite_email_delivery. When the invitee follows the link, api/service/accountinvite/onboarding/CounsellorOnboardingService.java (or api/service/accountinvite/onboarding/TenantAdminOnboardingService.java for tenant admins) walks the gates — e-mail verification, two-factor, DPA signature — before api/service/accountinvite/CounsellorInviteProvisioningService.java creates the real account.

flows.name: User logs in without a password via magic link
flows.summary: api/adapters/web/dto/MagicLinkRequestDTO.java carries the request into api/service/auth/MagicLinkLoginService.java, which mints a single-use token stored in Redis by api/service/auth/RedisOneTimeTokenStore.java and mails the link through api/service/email/OrisoEmailDispatcher.java. Consuming the link (api/adapters/web/dto/MagicLinkConsumeDTO.java) makes the service burn the token and exchange it for a Keycloak session through api/port/out/IdentitySessionExchange.java, implemented by api/adapters/keycloak/KeycloakIdentitySessionExchange.java. The same token store backs api/service/auth/PasswordResetService.java.

flows.name: Consultant creates, starts, joins and stops a group chat
flows.summary: POST /users/chat/v2/new goes through api/adapters/web/controller/UserChatControllerDelegate.java to api/facade/CreateChatFacade.java, which persists a Chat plus its ChatAgency links and creates the Matrix room. PUT /users/chat/{chatId}/start and .../stop run api/facade/StartChatFacade.java and api/facade/StopChatFacade.java, the latter delegating to api/actions/chat/StopChatActionCommand.java and api/actions/chat/ChatReCreator.java so a repeating chat gets a fresh room for the next occurrence. Membership is enforced by api/service/chat/GroupChatPermissionService.java and reconciled against Matrix by api/service/chat/GroupChatParticipantReconciliationService.java; occurrences and reminders are handled by api/service/chat/ChatOccurrenceCommandService.java and api/workflow/groupchatreminder/scheduler/GroupChatReminderScheduler.java.

flows.name: Account is deleted → scheduled cascade across DB, Keycloak and Matrix
flows.summary: DELETE /users/account on api/adapters/web/controller/UserAccountControllerDelegate.java does not erase anything immediately; it marks the account through api/workflow/delete/service/DeletionLifecycleService.java. api/workflow/delete/scheduler/DeleteUserAccountScheduler.java later picks up flagged accounts — claiming the run via api/workflow/scheduling/ScheduledTaskClaimService.java so replicas do not collide — and api/workflow/delete/service/DeleteUserAccountService.java executes the ordered actions: sessions and rooms (DeleteAskerRoomsAndSessionsAction), database rows (DeleteDatabaseAskerAction), Matrix user (DeleteMatrixUserAction) and Keycloak user (DeleteKeycloakUserAction). Residual errors are mailed by api/workflow/delete/service/WorkflowErrorMailService.java.

flows.name: Request arrives → tenant resolved and pinned for the transaction
flows.summary: api/adapters/web/controller/interceptor/HttpTenantFilter.java runs early in the chain, extracts the subdomain with api/adapters/web/controller/interceptor/SubdomainExtractor.java and asks api/tenant/TenantResolverService.java, which walks api/tenant/SubdomainTenantResolver.java, api/tenant/AccessTokenTenantResolver.java, api/tenant/CustomHeaderTenantResolver.java and api/tenant/TechnicalOrSuperAdminUserTenantResolver.java in order. The winner is written to api/tenant/TenantContext.java, from where api/service/TenantHibernateInterceptor.java scopes every JPA read and write, and api/service/httpheader/TenantHeaderSupplier.java forwards the tenant on outbound calls to the other ORISO services.

flows.name: Booked appointment turns into a counselling session
flows.summary: Appointments are read and written on api/adapters/web/controller/AppointmentController.java, backed by api/service/appointment/AppointmentService.java and api/port/out/AppointmentRepository.java, with GET /appointments/booking/{id} resolving the external booking id stored by migrate-add-booking-id-to-appointment.sql. POST /appointments/sessions/{sessionId}/enquiry/new converts a booking into a real counselling thread by delegating into the same api/facade/CreateEnquiryMessageFacade.java path used by ordinary enquiries, so the resulting Matrix room and notifications are identical. Stale appointments are removed by the replica-safe cleanup described in documentation/APPOINTMENT_CLEANUP_REPLICA_SAFETY.md.

layerDescriptions.Domain Concepts: The coarse business vocabulary of ORISO counselling as this backend implements it — session and enquiry lifecycle, consultation modes, case handover, invitations, identity and the deletion lifecycle.
layerDescriptions.API Endpoints: The 255 REST operations declared in the OpenAPI specifications this service generates its interfaces from, spanning /users, /conversations, /useradmin, /agencyadmin, /tenantadmin, /appointments, /statistics and /otp-config.
layerDescriptions.API Layer: Spring MVC controllers and their delegates under api/adapters/web/controller, the servlet filters that resolve tenant, correlation id and CSRF, the request/response DTOs and mappers, and the facades and services those controllers orchestrate.
layerDescriptions.Data Layer: JPA entities in api/model reached exclusively through the Spring Data interfaces in api/port/out, over a MariaDB schema owned by the Liquibase changesets under src/main/resources/db/changelog.
layerDescriptions.Core: Application bootstrap and cross-cutting wiring — UserServiceApplication, the manager/port facades AccountManager, IdentityManager, Messenger and Organizer, and the configuration under api/config for security, caching, Liquibase and outbound API clients.
layerDescriptions.Test Layer: The Python CI contract checks under tests/ci and tests/contracts (module boundaries, replica safety, OpenAPI gate, suite inventory) plus the load-test harnesses under tests/load.
